think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any specific numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable auto/meaning changes) rather than just “less/more”. 3) If such sentinel values exist and change semantics, classify as a special knob and list those values; otherwise classify as not special.
